macros.name: algdefaulttext
macros.doc: To make a command output the default text at the end of a block (say, you have changed the text for this block), use \algdefaulttext.

macros.name: algnotext
macros.doc: If <block> is missing, then the default text is changed, and if <block> is given, then the text displayed at the end of <block> is changed.

macros.name: algorithmicindent
macros.doc: The commands in a block are indented by \algorithmicindent (or another amount).

macros.name: algrestore
macros.doc: \algrestore{<savename>} restores the state of the algorithm saved under <savename> in this algorithmic block.

macros.name: algrestore*

macros.name: algstore
macros.doc: \algstore{<savename>} saves the line number, indentation, open blocks of the current algorithm and closes all blocks.

macros.name: algstore*
macros.doc: \algstore{<savename>} saves the line number, indentation, open blocks of the current algorithm and closes all blocks.

macros.name: Comment
macros.doc: Comments may be placed everywhere in the source using the \Comment macro (there are no limitations like those in the algorithmic package), feel the freedom!

macros.name: State
macros.doc: A simple line of text is beginned with \State.

envs.name: algorithmic
envs.doc: Each algorithm begins with the \begin{algorithmic}[lines] command, the optional lines controls the line numbering: 0 means no line numbering, 1 means number every line, and n means number lines n, 2n, 3n. . . until the \end{algorithmic} command, witch ends the algorithm.
